listing_title: Attico Unico Al Piano | Piscina Panoramica – Jesolo — JBC Immobiliare
raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / ATTICO UNICO AL PIANO | PISCINA PANORAMICA – JESOLO FOR SALE · PENTHOUSE Attico Unico Al Piano | Piscina Panoramica – Jesolo PIAZZA MAZZINI · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €880,000 Photos (19) Floor plans (0) 1 / 19 FLOOR AREA 130 m² BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT Yes ENERGY CLASS A3 Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo! In the heart of Jesolo Lido, in the renowned setting of Piazza Mazzini and just steps from the sea, this exclusive unique penthouse occupies the entire seventh level of an elegant residence with only seven housing units. The property makes a strong impression from the very first moment due to its exceptional natural brightness and perfect dialogue between indoor and outdoor spaces. The living area, refined and featuring contemporary design, flows seamlessly onto a large livable terrace: a true outdoor lounge with glimpses of the sea, designed for sunlit breakfasts, sunset aperitifs, and pleasant summer dinners. The sleeping area welcomes three spacious bedrooms, including an elegant master suite with en-suite bathroom, as well as a second designer bathroom serving the house. Crowning the property is the rooftop of the residence: a panoramic terrace reserved exclusively for residents, enriched by a spectacular pool from which one can dominate Jesolo's skyline while losing oneself in views of the sea in total tranquility. The independence of being on the top floor, exclusivity of sharing a pool with very few units, and convenience of having Via Bafile, beach access and all services within walking distance make this dwelling truly rare opportunity in Jesolo Lido’s real estate market. Ideal for those seeking prestigious accommodation characterized by spacious areas, three bedrooms, terrace overlooking sea views and high-level comfort.
